time_basis: bar open time, UTC seconds; sessions defined in UK local time (GMT/BST)

event.linked: same 5m candle and side -> one trade on the outermost level
event.corrected_definition: exclude a level if any bar between its session end and the in-session break already traded beyond it

footprint.pit: V/R/A on candle i use the 24 bars before i (known at i's close)
footprint.legacy: V/R/A on pre-break candles used the 24 bars before the BREAK candle (up to 10 min look-ahead)

rules.cont: enter at first 5m close beyond level within 3 bars; stop = opposite extreme of that bar
rules.fade: enter at first 5m close back inside within 3 bars; stop = level + (max excursion so far + 0.5)
rules.exit_check: bars after entry; stop checked before target in the same bar (tie = stop)

uncertainty.method: cluster bootstrap of mean per trade
